entries.title: A task's Activity shows what its crewmate did
entries.body: A task's Activity now lists each thing its crewmate did, such as reading a file or running the tests, in the crewmate's own words where it gave them. Each folds under the line it led to, so a line opens to show the work behind it.

picture.alt: A task's Activity with two lines opened to what the crewmate did before each, such as reading its log and running the journey three times
